questions.question: What is the main point made at the beginning of this passage about the treatise, despite the five earlier difficulties?
questions.answer: It says the work still has very great value and importance.

questions.question: Which respected figure is mentioned as having foretold the writing of this treatise?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two names are said to have been given to this work?
questions.answer: It was called the Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: How did Imam Ali treat this part of the Risale-i Nur according to the passage?
questions.answer: He gave it special attention and pointed people toward it.

questions.question: What event is mentioned in the note as confirming Imam Ali’s prediction?
questions.answer: The events in Denizli are said to have confirmed it.

questions.question: According to the note, what led to the imprisonment?
questions.answer: The hidden printing of the book led to the imprisonment.

questions.question: According to the same note, what was a main reason for acquittal and release?
questions.answer: The victory of the book’s sacred and powerful truth was a main reason.

questions.question: How does the note connect these events to Imam Ali’s earlier statement?
questions.answer: It presents the events as showing that his prediction and prayer were accepted.

questions.question: What relationship does the passage give between the Supreme Sign and the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It says the treatise explains that verse truly.

questions.question: What other place does this treatise hold within the larger work?
questions.answer: It is also identified as the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How is the treatise organized?
questions.answer: It has an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is included in the Introduction?
questions.answer: It presents four important topics.

questions.question: What is found in the First Station?
questions.answer: The Arabic part of the explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What is found in the Second Station?
questions.answer: The translation of that explanation along with its proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about the length of the Introduction?
questions.answer: He says it became longer than intended because there was a real need for that.

questions.question: What Qur’anic teaching closes the passage?
questions.answer: Human beings and jinn were created in order to worship Allah.

questions.question: In this passage, what overall claim is made about the status of the treatise?
questions.answer: It is presented as a highly significant work with special spiritual importance.

questions.question: Who is said to have had a miraculous awareness of its future composition?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What are the two titles linked to this treatise?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What example from later events is used to support the claim about Imam Ali’s foresight?
questions.answer: The imprisonment and later release connected to the book in Denizli.

questions.question: What was the cause of the imprisonment mentioned in the note?
questions.answer: It came from the secret printing of the treatise.

questions.question: What was said to help bring about freedom from that imprisonment?
questions.answer: The strength and victory of the truth taught in the book.

questions.question: What conclusion does the note draw from those events?
questions.answer: That they showed the truth of Imam Ali’s prediction and the acceptance of his prayer.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Supreme Sign explains?
questions.answer: It explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: Besides being an explanation of that verse, what else is the treatise called?
questions.answer: It is called the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How many important matters are in the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: What is special about the First Station compared with the Second Station?
questions.answer: The First Station is in Arabic, while the Second Station gives its translation and proofs.

questions.question: Why is the Second Station especially useful for readers who do not know Arabic well?
questions.answer: Because it provides the meaning in translation and supports it with evidence.

questions.question: What does the writer admit about the Introduction?
questions.answer: He admits that it was explained at greater length than he had planned.

questions.question: What reason is given for that extra length?
questions.answer: The length itself is taken as a sign that it was needed.

questions.question: What central purpose of creation is stated in the verse at the end?
questions.answer: The purpose is worship of Allah.

questions.question: What tension appears at the start of the passage between weakness and worth?
questions.answer: Even though the work has some difficulties and defects, it is still described as very important.

questions.question: Who is presented as recognizing that importance ahead of time?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: Name the two titles associated with the treatise in the passage.
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: Which historical setting is mentioned in the note?
questions.answer: Denizli.

questions.question: What happened there that is tied to the book?
questions.answer: There was imprisonment related to the book, followed by acquittal and release.

questions.question: What caused the imprisonment according to the note?
questions.answer: The secret publication of the book.

questions.question: What is presented as helping defeat the accusation?
questions.answer: The powerful and sacred truth of the work.

questions.question: How does the note use those events as evidence?
questions.answer: It uses them to show that the earlier prediction was fulfilled.

questions.question: What does the passage say this treatise is in relation to a verse?
questions.answer: It is an explanation of the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What does the passage say this treatise is in relation to the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray within it.

questions.question: How is the internal structure of the treatise described?
questions.answer: It is divided into an Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is the role of the Introduction?
questions.answer: It presents four important matters.

questions.question: What is the role of the First Station?
questions.answer: It gives the Arabic exposition of the verse.

questions.question: What is the role of the Second Station?
questions.answer: It gives the translation of that exposition and the proofs connected with it.

questions.question: Why does the writer say the Introduction became long?
questions.answer: Because there was a need that called for that amount of explanation.

questions.question: How does the final verse frame the whole work’s spiritual focus?
questions.answer: It centers the work on the purpose of creation as worshipping Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, should the earlier difficulties make readers think the treatise is minor or major?
questions.answer: Major, because the passage says it still has great importance.

questions.question: Which early Muslim figure is linked to that high status?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What action is attributed to him besides foreseeing the work?
questions.answer: He gave it special approval and drew attention to it.

questions.question: What are the two names he is said to have given it?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What later incident is mentioned as support for this claim?
questions.answer: The events in Denizli.

questions.question: What specific action connected to the book led to imprisonment?
questions.answer: Its secret printing.

questions.question: What outcome followed that imprisonment?
questions.answer: There was acquittal and release.

questions.question: What does the passage identify as a key cause of that favorable outcome?
questions.answer: The triumph of the book’s truth.

questions.question: What larger point is made through this story of imprisonment and release?
questions.answer: That Imam Ali’s earlier statement was shown to be true.

questions.question: What scriptural connection is made by calling the work an exposition of the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It connects the treatise directly to explaining an important Qur’anic verse.

questions.question: What literary connection is made by calling it the Seventh Ray?
questions.answer: It places the treatise within the structure of the Risale-i Nur.

questions.question: What are the main sections of the treatise?
questions.answer: The Introduction, the First Station, and the Second Station.

questions.question: What is covered in the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: What distinguishes the First Station from the Second Station in language and function?
questions.answer: The First is the Arabic exposition, while the Second gives its translation and proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about his intention regarding the Introduction’s length?
questions.answer: He did not originally intend for it to be so long.

questions.question: What explanation does he offer for why it became long anyway?
questions.answer: Its length shows there was a real need for more explanation.

questions.question: According to the final verse, what is the created purpose of jinn and mankind?
questions.answer: To worship Allah.

questions.question: What basic reassurance about the treatise appears at the start of the selected passage?
questions.answer: Its flaws do not cancel its great importance.

questions.question: Who is named as someone who anticipated the treatise before it appeared?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: In what way did he honor this work according to the passage?
questions.answer: He gave it special names and singled it out with favor.

questions.question: What are those special names?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What city is referred to in the note about later events?
questions.answer: Denizli.

questions.question: What book-related activity caused trouble there?
questions.answer: Printing the book secretly.

questions.question: What two legal results are mentioned after that trouble?
questions.answer: Acquittal and release.

questions.question: What spiritual lesson does the note draw from these events?
questions.answer: That the truth of the work was victorious and that Imam Ali’s prayer was accepted.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the treatise is a true exposition of the Supreme Verse?
questions.answer: It means the work gives a genuine explanation of that verse.

questions.question: What other title within the larger collection is given to the same treatise?
questions.answer: The Seventh Ray.

questions.question: How many major divisions does the treatise have?
questions.answer: Three: one Introduction and two Stations.

questions.question: What is the content of the Introduction?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: What is the content of the First Station?
questions.answer: The Arabic exposition of the verse.

questions.question: What is the content of the Second Station?
questions.answer: The translation of that exposition with proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer confess about the length of the Introduction?
questions.answer: He says it became longer than he meant it to be.

questions.question: How does he justify that length?
questions.answer: He says the need for it is shown by the very fact that it came out that way.

questions.question: What truth from the Qur’an is stated at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Jinn and human beings were created to worship Allah.

questions.question: If a student asks for the central idea of this selected passage, what is the best short summary?
questions.answer: The passage presents the treatise as spiritually important, explains its structure, and ends by grounding everything in the purpose of worship.

questions.question: Who is presented as having special insight into the treatise before its composition?
questions.answer: Imam Ali, may Allah be pleased with him.

questions.question: What two names are linked to the treatise through him?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign and the Staff of Moses.

questions.question: What evidence from later history is offered in the note?
questions.answer: The Denizli events involving imprisonment and later release.

questions.question: What directly caused the imprisonment mentioned there?
questions.answer: The concealed printing of the book.

questions.question: What is said to have played a major role in the acquittal?
questions.answer: The victorious force of the book’s sacred truth.

questions.question: How does this note function in the passage as a whole?
questions.answer: It serves as supporting evidence for the claim that the earlier prediction was real.

questions.question: What scriptural role does the treatise have according to the passage?
questions.answer: It explains the Supreme Verse.

questions.question: What place does it have within the Risale-i Nur?
questions.answer: It is the Seventh Ray.

questions.question: What are the treatise’s three parts?
questions.answer: An Introduction, a First Station, and a Second Station.

questions.question: What does the Introduction contain?
questions.answer: Four important matters.

questions.question: What does the First Station contain?
questions.answer: The Arabic section of the exposition.

questions.question: What does the Second Station contain?
questions.answer: The translation of the exposition together with proofs.

questions.question: What does the writer say about the amount of explanation in the Introduction?
questions.answer: He says more was said there than he had planned.

questions.question: How does the final Qur’anic line shape the reader’s understanding of the whole treatise?
questions.answer: It reminds the reader that the ultimate aim behind the discussion is worshipping Allah.
